baseline.transform: Static relative import prefix ./ replaced with ../../../dist/; implementation bytes otherwise preserved. Baseline and candidate share current dependencies and fixture geometry, isolating physics implementation differences.

scope: Actual fixed-step solver and production key-state mapping; no native keyboard, graphics, handling quality or real-vehicle claim. Baseline and candidate use the same current helper dependencies and isolated ground geometry.

checks.name: Production W+E+1 mapping preserves all three normalized requests
Historical G pitch loss is reproduced through the actual solver
Held G+W+E+1 now changes physical pitch without dropping translation/ascent
G+W+E+2 independently requests the opposite physical pitch
G remains armed during pitch override and returns to level after release
G-off pitch still holds the achieved attitude after release
Z/B keep their established G lateral-translation meaning, including simultaneous pitch
air-g-on-z physical trajectory remains exactly the historical no-pitch path
air-g-on-we physical trajectory remains exactly the historical no-pitch path
Grounded pitch without takeoff is explicitly reported instead of silently discarded
Simultaneous grounded W+E+1 reaches the hover pitch control path
Raw wrench mode accepts 1/2 pitch separately from W/S axial thrust
Every solver case remains finite within the actual nozzle capacities
pilot input release changes no body state/current nozzle force and retains automatic references
raw-valves input release changes no body state/current nozzle force and retains automatic references
pose-hold input release changes no body state/current nozzle force and retains automatic references
maneuver input release changes no body state/current nozzle force and retains automatic references
Releasing G pitch clears the active override immediately without snapping the body
Toggling G during a held pitch request keeps that request live, then levels on release
